_why: Canonical list for the layout guard (layout v2). ARCHITECTURE.md '## Folders' must list exactly these dirs plus ignored_dirs; tests/test_architecture.py enforces it.
_note_legacy: Frozen list: pre-existing per-version folders moved under engine/legacy/ (restructure phase 3), so nothing is exempt at the engine/ top any more. Never add to it.
_note_render_entries: Engine top folders that are a separate Remotion entry point (own index.tsx, own public dir), not a per-version/style copy of the main engine. jaab3d = the 3D shorts entry (engine/jaab3d/index.tsx). Add only for a real second entry point.
_note_asset_subdirs: engine/shared/ holds the shared public-dir assets (fonts, sfx, reference-study) staged into every render, so the engine code-extension rule does not apply there.
_note_ignored_dirs: Gitignored top-level dirs that still exist on disk: listed in ARCHITECTURE.md, never tracked. out/ goes away when the restructure's phase 8 migrates the old renders.
_note_depth: depth = path parts of a tracked file incl. top dir; null = no limit (_archive is frozen data). videos/<channel>/<id>/assets/approved/<id>/x.mp3 = 7; tools/pipeline/tts/x.py = 4; docs/briefs/x.md = 3.
